card.statement:
Let $V$ be an arbitrary nonzero level $\Z$-graded module over $G$. Fix $k_1, \ldots, k_s\in \Z$ and $f_i\in G_{k_i\delta}$, $i=1, \ldots, s$ and set $f_0=1$. Also fix nonzero elements $x_k\in G_{k\delta}$, $k\in \Z\setminus\{0\}$ such that $[x_i, x_{-i}]\neq 0$ for any $i$. Then for any nonzero homogeneous element $v\in
 V$ there exists $N\in \Z$ such that

$$\sum_{i=0}^s x_{N-i} f_iv\neq 0.$$
card.label: Lemma 4

paper.title: Structure of parabolically induced modules for affine Kac-Moody algebras
paper.abstract: The main result of the paper establishes the irreducibility of a large family of nonzero central charge induced modules over Affine Lie algebras for any non standard parabolic subalgebra. It generalizes all previously known partial results and provides a a construction of many new irreducible modules.
